title: Volvo XC40 has a new look, better sensors, and Gemini AI
summary: Today, Volvo announced it was giving its hybrid XC40 a major facelift. When it arrives at dealerships early next year, the new XC40 will have updated exterior styling, a gut-renovated interior featuring Google's Gemini AI assistant, enlarged infotainment screen, and a new sensor-and-software safety suite.
